name: Oneida County, NY
findings: Oneida County has 698 nonprofit organizations. 330 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 271 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Oneida County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 16 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Oneida County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
